verses.original: Λαλούντων δὲ αὐτῶν πρὸς τὸν λαὸν ἐπέστησαν αὐτοῖς οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ ὁ στρατηγὸς τοῦ ἱεροῦ καὶ οἱ Σαδδουκαῖοι
verses.transliteration: Lalountōn de autōn pros ton laon epestēsan autois hoi hiereis kai ho stratēgos tou hierou kai hoi Saddoukaioi
verses.literal: While Peter and John were speaking to the people the priests and the captain of the temple guard and the Sadducees came up to them
verses.literalPt: Enquanto Pedro e João falavam ao povo, sobrevieram-lhes os sacerdotes, o capitão do templo e os saduceus,

verses.original: διαπονούμενοι διὰ τὸ διδάσκειν αὐτοὺς τὸν λαὸν καὶ καταγγέλλειν ἐν τῷ Ἰησοῦ τὴν ἀνάστασιν τὴν ἐκ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: diaponoumenoi dia to didaskein autous ton laon kai katangellein en tō Iēsou tēn anastasin tēn ek nekrōn
verses.literal: greatly disturbed that they were teaching the people and proclaiming in Jesus the resurrection of the dead
verses.literalPt: enfadados por ensinarem eles o povo e anunciarem em Jesus a ressurreição dentre os mortos;

verses.original: καὶ ἐπέβαλον αὐτοῖς τὰς χεῖρας καὶ ἔθεντο εἰς τήρησιν εἰς τὴν αὔριον ἦν γὰρ ἑσπέρα ἤδη
verses.transliteration: kai epebalon autois tas cheiras kai ethento eis tērēsin eis tēn aurion ēn gar hespera ēdē
verses.literal: They seized . . . . . . Peter and John and because it was evening they put them in custody until the next day
verses.literalPt: deitaram mão neles e os detiveram até o dia seguinte, pois já tinha chegado a tarde.

verses.original: πολλοὶ δὲ τῶν ἀκουσάντων τὸν λόγον ἐπίστευσαν καὶ ἐγενήθη ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῶν ἀνδρῶν ὡς χιλιάδες πέντε
verses.transliteration: polloi de tōn akousantōn ton logon episteusan kai egenēthē ho arithmos tōn andrōn hōs chiliades pente
verses.literal: But many who heard the message believed and the number of men grew to about five thousand
verses.literalPt: Muitos, porém, dos que ouviram a palavra creram; e elevou-se o número dos homens a quase cinco mil.

verses.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐπὶ τὴν αὔριον συναχθῆναι αὐτῶν τοὺς ἄρχοντας καὶ τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους καὶ τοὺς γραμματεῖς ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ
verses.transliteration: Egeneto de epi tēn aurion synachthēnai autōn tous archontas kai tous presbyterous kai tous grammateis en Ierousalēm
verses.literal: - The next day the rulers - elders and scribes assembled in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: No dia seguinte, reuniram-se em Jerusalém as autoridades, os anciãos, os escribas,

verses.original: καὶ Ἅννας ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς καὶ Καϊάφας καὶ Ἰωάννης καὶ Ἀλέξανδρος καὶ ὅσοι ἦσαν ἐκ γένους ἀρχιερατικοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai Hannas ho archiereus kai Kaiaphas kai Iōannēs kai Alexandros kai hosoi ēsan ek genous archieratikou
verses.literal: along with Annas the high priest Caiaphas John Alexander and many others . . . from the high priest’s family
verses.literalPt: Anás, que era o sumo sacerdote, Caifás, João, Alexandre e todos os que eram da linhagem do sumo sacerdote;

verses.original: καὶ στήσαντες αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ μέσῳ ἐπυνθάνοντο Ἐν ποίᾳ δυνάμει ἢ ἐν ποίῳ ὀνόματι ἐποιήσατε τοῦτο ὑμεῖς
verses.transliteration: kai stēsantes autous en tō mesō epynthanonto En poia dynamei ē en poiō onomati epoiēsate touto hymeis
verses.literal: They had Peter and John brought in and began to question them By what power or what name did you do this
verses.literalPt: e, pondo-os no meio deles, perguntavam: Com que poder ou em que nome fizestes vós isso?

verses.original: Τότε Πέτρος πλησθεὶς Πνεύματος Ἁγίου εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Ἄρχοντες τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ πρεσβύτεροι
verses.transliteration: Tote Petros plēstheis Pneumatos Hagiou eipen pros autous Archontes tou laou kai presbyteroi
verses.literal: Then Peter filled with the Holy Spirit said to them Rulers and elders of the people
verses.literalPt: Então, Pedro, cheio do Espírito Santo, lhes disse: Autoridades do povo e anciãos,

verses.original: εἰ ἡμεῖς σήμερον ἀνακρινόμεθα ἐπὶ εὐεργεσίᾳ ἀνθρώπου ἀσθενοῦς ἐν τίνι οὗτος σέσωσται
verses.transliteration: ei hēmeis sēmeron anakrinometha epi euergesia anthrōpou asthenous en tini houtos sesōstai
verses.literal: If we are being examined today about a kind service to a man who was lame to determine how he was healed
verses.literalPt: se nós hoje somos inquiridos sobre o benefício feito a um enfermo, como foi ele curado,

verses.original: γνωστὸν ἔστω πᾶσιν ὑμῖν καὶ παντὶ τῷ λαῷ Ἰσραὴλ ὅτι ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ Ναζωραίου ὃν ὑμεῖς ἐσταυρώσατε ὃν ὁ Θεὸς ἤγειρεν ἐκ νεκρῶν ἐν τούτῳ οὗτος παρέστηκεν ἐνώπιον ὑμῶν ὑγιής
verses.transliteration: gnōston estō pasin hymin kai panti tō laō Israēl hoti en tō onomati Iēsou Christou tou Nazōraiou hon hymeis estaurōsate hon ho Theos ēgeiren ek nekrōn en toutō houtos parestēken enōpion hymōn hygiēs
verses.literal: then let this be known to all of you and to all the people of Israel It is by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth whom you crucified but whom God raised from the dead that . . . this man stands before you healed
verses.literalPt: seja notório a todos vós e a todo o povo de Israel que em o nome de Jesus Cristo, o Nazareno, a quem vós crucificastes e a quem Deus ressuscitou dentre os mortos, nesse nome está este enfermo aqui são diante de vós.

verses.original: οὗτός ἐστιν Ὁ λίθος ὁ ἐξουθενηθεὶς ὑφ’ ὑμῶν τῶν οἰκοδόμων ὁ γενόμενος εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας
verses.transliteration: houtos estin Ho lithos ho exouthenētheis hyph’ hymōn tōn oikodomōn ho genomenos eis kephalēn gōnias
verses.literal: This Jesus is the stone you builders rejected which has become . . . the cornerstone . . .
verses.literalPt: Ele é a pedra desprezada por vós, edificadores, a qual foi posta como a pedra angular.

verses.original: Καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν ἄλλῳ οὐδενὶ ἡ σωτηρία οὐδὲ γὰρ ὄνομά ἐστιν ἕτερον ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανὸν τὸ δεδομένον ἐν ἀνθρώποις ἐν ᾧ δεῖ σωθῆναι ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Kai ouk estin en allō oudeni hē sōtēria oude gar onoma estin heteron hypo ton ouranon to dedomenon en anthrōpois en hō dei sōthēnai hēmas
verses.literal: Salvation exists in no one else for there is no other name under heaven given to men by which we must be saved
verses.literalPt: Não há salvação em nenhum outro; porque abaixo do céu não há outro nome dado entre os homens, em que devamos ser salvos.

verses.original: Θεωροῦντες δὲ τὴν τοῦ Πέτρου παρρησίαν καὶ Ἰωάννου καὶ καταλαβόμενοι ὅτι ἄνθρωποι ἀγράμματοί εἰσιν καὶ ἰδιῶται ἐθαύμαζον ἐπεγίνωσκόν τε αὐτοὺς ὅτι σὺν τῷ Ἰησοῦ ἦσαν
verses.transliteration: Theōrountes de tēn tou Petrou parrēsian kai Iōannou kai katalabomenoi hoti anthrōpoi agrammatoi eisin kai idiōtai ethaumazon epeginōskon te autous hoti syn tō Iēsou ēsan
verses.literal: When they saw the boldness of Peter and John and realized that they were unschooled ordinary men they marveled and took note that these men had been with Jesus
verses.literalPt: Ao verem a intrepidez de Pedro e João e tendo notado que eram iletrados e indoutos, maravilhavam-se; e reconheciam que haviam eles estado com Jesus;

verses.original: τόν τε ἄνθρωπον βλέποντες σὺν αὐτοῖς ἑστῶτα τὸν τεθεραπευμένον οὐδὲν εἶχον ἀντειπεῖν
verses.transliteration: ton te anthrōpon blepontes syn autois hestōta ton tetherapeumenon ouden eichon anteipein
verses.literal: And seeing the man who had been healed standing there with them they had nothing to say in response
verses.literalPt: e, vendo com eles o homem que fora curado, nada tinham que dizer em contrário.

verses.original: κελεύσαντες δὲ αὐτοὺς ἔξω τοῦ συνεδρίου ἀπελθεῖν συνέβαλλον πρὸς ἀλλήλους
verses.transliteration: keleusantes de autous exō tou synedriou apelthein syneballon pros allēlous
verses.literal: So they ordered them to leave . . . the Sanhedrin and then conferred together
verses.literalPt: Mandaram-nos sair do Sinédrio e consultavam entre si,

verses.original: λέγοντες Τί ποιήσωμεν τοῖς ἀνθρώποις τούτοις ὅτι μὲν γὰρ γνωστὸν σημεῖον γέγονεν δι’ αὐτῶν πᾶσιν τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Ἰερουσαλὴμ φανερόν καὶ οὐ δυνάμεθα ἀρνεῖσθαι
verses.transliteration: legontes Ti poiēsōmen tois anthrōpois toutois hoti men gar gnōston sēmeion gegonen di’ autōn pasin tois katoikousin Ierousalēm phaneron kai ou dynametha arneisthai
verses.literal: What shall we do with these men they asked It is clear to everyone living in Jerusalem that a remarkable miracle has occurred through them and we cannot deny it
verses.literalPt: dizendo: Que faremos a estes homens? Pois, na verdade, é manifesto a todos os que habitam em Jerusalém que um milagre notório foi por eles feito, e não o podemos negar;

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ἵνα μὴ ἐπὶ πλεῖον διανεμηθῇ εἰς τὸν λαόν ἀπειλησώμεθα αὐτοῖς μηκέτι λαλεῖν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τούτῳ μηδενὶ ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: all’ hina mē epi pleion dianemēthē eis ton laon apeilēsōmetha autois mēketi lalein epi tō onomati toutō mēdeni anthrōpōn
verses.literal: But to keep this message from spreading any further among the people we must warn them not to speak to anyone in this name
verses.literalPt: mas, para que não se divulgue mais entre o povo, ameacemo-los que, de ora em diante, não falem nesse nome a homem algum.

verses.original: Καὶ καλέσαντες αὐτοὺς παρήγγειλαν τὸ καθόλου μὴ φθέγγεσθαι μηδὲ διδάσκειν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai kalesantes autous parēngeilan to katholou mē phthengesthai mēde didaskein epi tō onomati tou Iēsou
verses.literal: Then they called them in again and commanded them not to speak or teach at all in the name of Jesus
verses.literalPt: Chamando-os, ordenaram-lhes que absolutamente não falassem, nem ensinassem em o nome de Jesus.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Πέτρος καὶ Ἰωάννης ἀποκριθέντες εἶπον πρὸς αὐτούς Εἰ δίκαιόν ἐστιν ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ ὑμῶν ἀκούειν μᾶλλον ἢ τοῦ Θεοῦ κρίνατε
verses.transliteration: Ho de Petros kai Iōannēs apokrithentes eipon pros autous Ei dikaion estin enōpion tou Theou hymōn akouein mallon ē tou Theou krinate
verses.literal: But Peter and John replied . . . . . . . . . Judge for yourselves whether it is right in God’s sight . . . . . . to listen to you rather than God
verses.literalPt: Mas Pedro e João responderam-lhes: Se é justo diante de Deus ouvir-vos a vós antes do que a Deus, julgai-o vós,

verses.original: οὐ δυνάμεθα γὰρ ἡμεῖς ἃ εἴδαμεν καὶ ἠκούσαμεν μὴ λαλεῖν
verses.transliteration: ou dynametha gar hēmeis ha eidamen kai ēkousamen mē lalein
verses.literal: For we cannot stop speaking about what we have seen and heard
verses.literalPt: pois nós não podemos deixar de falar das coisas que vimos e ouvimos.

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ προσαπειλησάμενοι ἀπέλυσαν αὐτούς μηδὲν εὑρίσκοντες τὸ πῶς κολάσωνται αὐτούς διὰ τὸν λαόν ὅτι πάντες ἐδόξαζον τὸν Θεὸν ἐπὶ τῷ γεγονότι
verses.transliteration: Hoi de prosapeilēsamenoi apelysan autous mēden heuriskontes to pōs kolasōntai autous dia ton laon hoti pantes edoxazon ton Theon epi tō gegonoti
verses.literal: After further threats they let them go . . . They could not find a way . . . . . . to punish them because all the people were glorifying God for what had happened
verses.literalPt: Depois de os ameaçarem ainda mais, soltaram-nos, não achando motivo para os castigar por causa do povo, porque todos glorificavam a Deus pelo que acontecera.

verses.original: ἐτῶν γὰρ ἦν πλειόνων τεσσεράκοντα ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐφ’ ὃν γεγόνει τὸ σημεῖον τοῦτο τῆς ἰάσεως
verses.transliteration: etōn gar ēn pleionōn tesserakonta ho anthrōpos eph’ hon gegonei to sēmeion touto tēs iaseōs
verses.literal: For the man who - was miraculously healed . . . was over forty years old
verses.literalPt: Ora, tinha mais de quarenta anos o homem em que se operara essa cura milagrosa.

verses.original: Ἀπολυθέντες δὲ ἦλθον πρὸς τοὺς ἰδίους καὶ ἀπήγγειλαν ὅσα πρὸς αὐτοὺς οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι εἶπαν
verses.transliteration: Apolythentes de ēlthon pros tous idious kai apēngeilan hosa pros autous hoi archiereis kai hoi presbyteroi eipan
verses.literal: On their release Peter and John returned to their own people and reported everything that the chief priests and elders had said to them
verses.literalPt: Depois de soltos, foram aos seus e relataram tudo quanto lhes haviam dito os principais sacerdotes e os anciãos.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ἀκούσαντες ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἦραν φωνὴν πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν καὶ εἶπαν Δέσποτα σὺ ὁ ποιήσας τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: hoi de akousantes homothymadon ēran phōnēn pros ton Theon kai eipan Despota sy ho poiēsas ton ouranon kai tēn gēn kai tēn thalassan kai panta ta en autois
verses.literal: When the believers heard this they lifted up their voices to God with one accord Sovereign Lord they said You made the heaven and the earth and the sea and everything in them
verses.literalPt: Eles, ouvindo isso, levantaram unanimemente a voz a Deus e disseram: Senhor, tu que fizeste o céu, a terra, o mar e tudo o que neles há;

verses.original: ὁ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν διὰ Πνεύματος Ἁγίου στόματος Δαυὶδ παιδός σου εἰπών Ἵνα‿ Τί ἐφρύαξαν ἔθνη καὶ λαοὶ ἐμελέτησαν κενά
verses.transliteration: ho tou patros hēmōn dia Pneumatos Hagiou stomatos Dauid paidos sou eipōn Hina Ti ephryaxan ethnē kai laoi emeletēsan kena
verses.literal: You spoke by the Holy Spirit through the mouth of Your servant our father David Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain
verses.literalPt: tu que, pelo Espírito Santo, por boca de nosso pai Davi, teu servo, disseste: Por que se enfureceram os gentios, e os povos imaginaram coisas vãs?

verses.original: παρέστησαν οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες συνήχθησαν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ κατὰ τοῦ Κυρίου καὶ κατὰ τοῦ Χριστοῦ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: parestēsan hoi basileis tēs gēs kai hoi archontes synēchthēsan epi to auto kata tou Kyriou kai kata tou Christou autou
verses.literal: The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together . . . . . . against the Lord and against His Anointed One
verses.literalPt: Levantaram-se os reis da terra, e as autoridades ajuntaram-se à uma contra o Senhor e contra o seu Ungido;

verses.original: Συνήχθησαν γὰρ ἐπ’ ἀληθείας ἐν τῇ πόλει ταύτῃ ἐπὶ τὸν ἅγιον Παῖδά σου Ἰησοῦν ὃν ἔχρισας Ἡρῴδης τε καὶ Πόντιος Πιλᾶτος σὺν ἔθνεσιν καὶ λαοῖς Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: Synēchthēsan gar ep’ alētheias en tē polei tautē epi ton hagion Paida sou Iēsoun hon echrisas Hērōdēs te kai Pontios Pilatos syn ethnesin kai laois Israēl
verses.literal: In fact this is the very city where Herod and Pontius Pilate conspired with the Gentiles and the people of Israel against Your holy servant Jesus whom You anointed
verses.literalPt: pois verdadeiramente se ajuntaram nesta cidade contra o teu Santo Servo Jesus, ao qual ungiste, não só Herodes, mas também Pôncio Pilatos, com os gentios e com o povo de Israel,

verses.original: ποιῆσαι ὅσα ἡ χείρ σου καὶ ἡ βουλὴ σου προώρισεν γενέσθαι
verses.transliteration: poiēsai hosa hē cheir sou kai hē boulē sou proōrisen genesthai
verses.literal: They carried out what Your hand and - will had decided beforehand would happen
verses.literalPt: para fazerem tudo o que a tua mão e o teu conselho predeterminaram que se fizesse.

verses.original: καὶ τὰ νῦν Κύριε ἔπιδε ἐπὶ τὰς ἀπειλὰς αὐτῶν καὶ δὸς τοῖς δούλοις σου μετὰ παρρησίας πάσης λαλεῖν τὸν λόγον σου
verses.transliteration: kai ta nyn Kyrie epide epi tas apeilas autōn kai dos tois doulois sou meta parrēsias pasēs lalein ton logon sou
verses.literal: And now Lord consider . . . their threats and enable Your servants to speak Your word with complete boldness
verses.literalPt: Agora, Senhor, olha para as suas ameaças e concede aos teus servos que, com toda a liberdade, falem a tua palavra,

verses.original: ἐν τῷ τὴν χεῖρά σου ἐκτείνειν σε εἰς ἴασιν καὶ σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα γίνεσθαι διὰ τοῦ ὀνόματος τοῦ ἁγίου Παιδός σου Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: en tō tēn cheira sou ekteinein se eis iasin kai sēmeia kai terata ginesthai dia tou onomatos tou hagiou Paidos sou Iēsou
verses.literal: as . . . You stretch out Your hand to heal and perform signs and wonders through the name of Your holy servant Jesus
verses.literalPt: enquanto tu estendes a mão para curar e para que se façam milagres e prodígios pelo nome de teu Santo Servo Jesus.

verses.original: Καὶ δεηθέντων αὐτῶν ἐσαλεύθη ὁ τόπος ἐν ᾧ ἦσαν συνηγμένοι καὶ ἐπλήσθησαν ἅπαντες τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος καὶ ἐλάλουν τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ μετὰ παρρησίας
verses.transliteration: Kai deēthentōn autōn esaleuthē ho topos en hō ēsan synēgmenoi kai eplēsthēsan hapantes tou Hagiou Pneumatos kai elaloun ton logon tou Theou meta parrēsias
verses.literal: After they had prayed their meeting place . . . . . . was shaken and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly
verses.literalPt: Tendo eles orado, tremeu o lugar onde estavam reunidos; todos ficaram cheios do Espírito Santo e falavam com liberdade a palavra de Deus.

verses.original: Τοῦ δὲ πλήθους τῶν πιστευσάντων ἦν καρδία καὶ ψυχὴ μία καὶ οὐδὲ εἷς τι τῶν ὑπαρχόντων αὐτῷ ἔλεγεν ἴδιον εἶναι ἀλλ’ ἦν αὐτοῖς πάντα κοινά
verses.transliteration: Tou de plēthous tōn pisteusantōn ēn kardia kai psychē mia kai oude heis ti tōn hyparchontōn autō elegen idion einai all’ ēn autois panta koina
verses.literal: The multitude of believers was one in heart and soul No one claimed that any of his possessions was his own but they shared . . . . . . everything they owned
verses.literalPt: Da comunidade dos que creram o coração era um, e a alma, uma, e nenhum deles dizia que coisa alguma das que possuía era sua própria, mas tudo entre eles era comum.

verses.original: καὶ δυνάμει μεγάλῃ ἀπεδίδουν τὸ μαρτύριον οἱ ἀπόστολοι τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ τῆς ἀναστάσεως χάρις τε μεγάλη ἦν ἐπὶ πάντας αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: kai dynamei megalē apedidoun to martyrion hoi apostoloi tou Kyriou Iēsou tēs anastaseōs charis te megalē ēn epi pantas autous
verses.literal: With great power the apostles continued to give their testimony about the resurrection of the Lord Jesus And abundant grace was upon them all
verses.literalPt: Com grande poder, os apóstolos davam o seu testemunho da ressurreição do Senhor Jesus, e em todos eles havia abundante graça.

verses.original: Οὐδὲ γὰρ ἐνδεής τις ἦν ἐν αὐτοῖς ὅσοι γὰρ κτήτορες χωρίων ἢ οἰκιῶν ὑπῆρχον πωλοῦντες ἔφερον τὰς τιμὰς τῶν πιπρασκομένων
verses.transliteration: Oude gar endeēs tis ēn en autois hosoi gar ktētores chōriōn ē oikiōn hypērchon pōlountes epheron tas timas tōn pipraskomenōn
verses.literal: There were no needy ones among them because those who owned lands or houses would sell their property bring the proceeds from the sales
verses.literalPt: Pois nenhum necessitado havia entre eles, porque todos os que possuíam terras ou casas, vendendo-as, traziam o preço do que vendiam

verses.original: καὶ ἐτίθουν παρὰ τοὺς πόδας τῶν ἀποστόλων διεδίδετο δὲ ἑκάστῳ καθότι ἄν τις χρείαν εἶχεν
verses.transliteration: kai etithoun para tous podas tōn apostolōn diedideto de hekastō kathoti an tis chreian eichen
verses.literal: and lay them at the apostles’ feet for distribution to anyone as . . . he had need
verses.literalPt: e depositavam-no aos pés dos apóstolos; e repartia-se a cada um conforme a sua necessidade.

verses.original: Ἰωσὴφ δὲ ὁ ἐπικληθεὶς Βαρνάβας ἀπὸ τῶν ἀποστόλων ὅ ἐστιν μεθερμηνευόμενον Υἱὸς παρακλήσεως Λευίτης Κύπριος τῷ γένει
verses.transliteration: Iōsēph de ho epiklētheis Barnabas apo tōn apostolōn ho estin methermēneuomenon Huios paraklēseōs Leuitēs Kyprios tō genei
verses.literal: Joseph a Levite from Cyprus . . . . . . whom the apostles called Barnabas ( meaning Son of Encouragement
verses.literalPt: José, a quem os apóstolos deram o sobrenome de Barnabé (que quer dizer filho de exortação), levita, natural de Chipre,

verses.original: ὑπάρχοντος αὐτῷ ἀγροῦ πωλήσας ἤνεγκεν τὸ χρῆμα καὶ ἔθηκεν πρὸς τοὺς πόδας τῶν ἀποστόλων
verses.transliteration: hyparchontos autō agrou pōlēsas ēnenken to chrēma kai ethēken pros tous podas tōn apostolōn
verses.literal: sold a field he owned brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet
verses.literalPt: como tivesse um campo, vendeu-o, trouxe o preço e depositou-o aos pés dos apóstolos.
